command:
cp proof.txt /tmp/opencode/proof.bak && \
sed 's/final step 6.11/final step 6.99/' proof.txt > /tmp/opencode/p1.txt && \
sed 's/\[by IND L3 (6.9, 6.10)\]/[by IND L9 (6.9, 6.10)]/' proof.txt > /tmp/opencode/p2.txt && \
sed 's/OBL-3: PROVED/OBL-3: PROVED via sorry/' proof.txt > /tmp/opencode/p3.txt && \
sed 's/6.11\. |- forall L. sorted(sort_list(L))/6.11. |- forall L. sorted(quick_sort(L))/' proof.txt > /tmp/opencode/p4.txt && \
for f in p1 p2 p3 p4; do
  python3 checker.py /tmp/opencode/$f.txt > /tmp/opencode/$f.out 2>&1
  echo "$f: exit=$? $(grep -c -i 'reject\|fail\|error' /tmp/opencode/$f.out) rejection-terms"
done; python3 checker.py proof.txt > /tmp/opencode/pass.out 2>&1; echo "original: exit=$?"
